title: Unoverse object make function
description: api/make.yaml: the object's private make function (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md 4b, 2026-09-14): one function with no name inside it, the extra reading the pipeline does before it writes the object (a product's whole page, a fund's documents). Only the pipeline runs it. A prop written from it says from: make.<return>. An object the pipeline writes from what it already has (a need, a table, a figure) has no make.yaml.

name.description: The call's name; later calls and returns read its outputs as calls.<name>.<output>.

node.description: The node this call runs, by type (S3FileContent). The node carries its credential, hosts and interface; its credential is found by type in the org's store.

config.description: The node's config, with {{ row.* }}, {{ calls.<name>.* }}, {{ item }} references and return expressions.

when.description: A sandboxed `return ...` expression or a {{ }} reference, evaluated by the platform's SafeExpression evaluator.

for.description: A reference to a list: run the call once per item, item in scope; the outputs are an aligned array.

optional.description: A best-effort call: when it fails the function goes on and its reply is null (under `for`, null in that item's place). A model's second look, never the read itself.

inputs.description: What the node takes wired on a canvas (a parse's etag), resolved like config. Under `for` the item rides in beside them.

cacheable.description: REMEMBERED, WHERE THE CALL KNOWS SOMETHING THE NODE CANNOT. A node declares whether its KIND of answer may be reused, and a general model call declares false, rightly: a prompt and a model are the caller's. A CALL is narrower than its node and may fix the prompt, fix the model, and hand it an input that cannot change. Only the call's author is in a position to say so, so a call may declare its own memory. It must name what makes its input the same input: `key` is required, because "this is repeatable" is a claim about the INPUT, and a claim with nothing to point at is a hope.

ignore.description: Config fields dropped from the fingerprint because they are the input's transport, not its identity (an inlined image, a presigned URL).

key.description: Input leaf fields that identify what was asked, matched by dot-suffix against the resolved inputs. A key that collects nothing disables the memory for that run.

returns.description: The function's outputs: a record of {{ }} references or return expressions over row, calls and item, or one expression for the whole.
